messages:
marta: getting multiple restore failures in the restore pipeline for snapshots from 2026-05-10. error from restore-worker: KMS AccessDenied for key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/oldrot-0001 when trying to Decrypt.
liam: is that the old CMK we rotated last night? we rotated to arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/newrot-0002 at 2026-05-10T03:00Z.
sunita: checking KMS console: key/oldrot-0001 is in PENDING_DELETION state with deletion_date 2026-05-17T03:05:00Z. looks like the rotation automation scheduled deletion instead of retiring it.
kms-admin: confirm: automated-key-rotation job v2.3 attempted to schedule key retirement but a bug in the step ordering called ScheduleKeyDeletion on the old key before creating grants for the new key. the job ran at 2026-05-10T03:05:03Z.
marta: that explains AccessDenied - pending deletion keys reject Encrypt/Decrypt. but some objects were still encrypted with the old key. can we cancel deletion?
oncall-sre: yes AWS allows CancelKeyDeletion within window. can we cancel for oldrot-0001 immediately?
kms-admin: running cancel now. `aws kms cancel-key-deletion --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/oldrot-0001` executed at 2026-05-10T04:12:10Z. key now Enabled.
infra-bot: recorded ci job: automated-key-rotation v2.3 invoked by ci-scheduler commit b7c1e. plan link: https://git.internal/infra/plan/kms-rotate-b7c1e.
liam: while deletion was pending some restores failed. do we have logs to show which restores error'd and which tenants were impacted?
marta: restore job logs show 12 failed jobs between 2026-05-10T03:06 and 03:42 referencing object keys under backups/2026-05-09/tenant-18 and tenant-73.
security-bot: ran CloudTrail query: found ScheduleKeyDeletion call by principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/kms-rotator at 2026-05-10T03:05:03Z. also detected no CreateGrant calls for newrot-0002 before the deletion scheduling. flagged as automation mis-sequence.
compliance: this could be an availability incident; any data exposure risk? seems not: objects remain encrypted and not publicly accessible. primary impact is restore availability.
liam: remediation steps: 1) cancel deletion (done) 2) re-run restore jobs for failed tenants 3) patch rotation job to create new key grants before scheduling deletion 4) add CI/unit test to simulate ordering 5) add monitoring: alarm when key state moves to PendingDeletion for any key tagged redwood:backup=true.
sunita: re-runs started at 2026-05-10T04:20Z. initial smoke shows restores for tenant-18 succeeded. re-run status: 9/12 completed, 3 still retrying.
oncall-sre: also recommend temporary rollback of automated rotation until patch merged. setting rotation pipeline to manual and locking scheduler.
kms-admin: opened PR to fix sequence in job: https://git.internal/infra/ci/pulls/610 - change to create new grants and test Decrypt before scheduling deletion.
security-bot: added detection rule: CloudWatch Event for KMS Key StateChange -> if new state == PendingDeletion and resource tag backup=true -> page eng-security and oncall. created alert INF-6109.
compliance: please keep incident log with timestamps for customer notifications if restores were missed beyond SLA. also collect proof-of-cancel and re-run checksums.
marta: adding checksum diffs to ticket INF-6109. all re-runs have matching sha256 so far. will mark incident as SEV-2 until all retries complete.
liam: long term: - add CI gate to prevent schedule deletion from being used by rotation job unless explicit opt-in - make key rotation idempotent and safe (create grants, validate decrypt, only then schedule old deletion) - add automated smoke test after rotation that runs sample restores from last 24h - harden IAM: restrict who can schedule key deletion to small admin group.
sunita: also tagging all backup CMKs with `redwood:system=backups` so janitors ignore them unless explicitly approved. opening infra PR for tag enforcement.
oncall-sre: keeping oncall informed. closing notes: cancel deletion successful, restores progressing, PR for rotation fix in review. will update ticket when complete.
